query:
SELECT a.id, a.url, a.language, cj.id as jobId, cj.status FROM audits a LEFT JOIN citation_jobs cj ON cj.auditId = a.id WHERE a.id = 3450002;
SELECT id, engine, query, isCited, round FROM citation_checks WHERE jobId IN (SELECT id FROM citation_jobs WHERE auditId = 3450002) ORDER BY id LIMIT 20;
